sloka: ततो रामशरान् दृष्ट्वा विमानेषु गृहेषु च।सन्नाहो राक्षसेन्द्राणां तुमुलः समपद्यत ।। ६.७५.३९ ।।
transliteration: tato rāmaśarān dṛṣṭvā vimāneṣu gṛheṣu ca।sannāho rākṣasendrāṇāṁ tumulaḥ samapadyata ।। 6.75.39 ।।

translations.english: The sound of Rama's bow twang, the clamour of the Vanaras as well as the wailing of Rakshasas, all the three could be heard in all ten directions.
